newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 closes lower in quiet trading.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 closes lower in quiet trading.

text.p: The Czech PX50 declined in quiet trading on Monday with dealers seeing nervousness on the market ahead of Wednesday's expected government announcement of a package of economic measures designed to stimulate growth.
The uncertain picture on the equities market was magnified by instability in the foreign exchange markets where the Czech crown fell sharply against its mark/dollar basket.
With activity on the bourse remaining low, the PX50 dropped almost 0.5 percent to 548.5.
"Probably now, the nervousness around the government measures is a little bit distracting," said Lubomir Vystavel of ING Barings.
The heaviest decliner among the blue chips was Komercni Banka, which fell 65 crowns, 2.8 percent, to 2,247.
Vystavel said that at current levels Komercni, the PX50's most heavily weighted banking stock, was looking attractively priced.
Elsewhere, SPT Telecom fell six crowns to 3,435, CEZ lost 30 crowns to 1,043 and Ceska Sporitelna edged two crowns higher to 305.
